_nota: Pedido del 522 v4 (orden del dueño 23/11 22:57): Jambo ha pinchado la luz para un cultivo de «tomates» en el trastero. Esta noche solo se diseña la voz B2 de Jambo (sin_generar); el 24/11 tras las 09:00 se quita «sin_generar» y «muestras» y se generan los cinco personajes. Uso general: ver herramientas/estudio/LEEME.md («Voces nuevas»).

muestras.descripcion: A skinny, scruffy, worn-out man in his late 40s from a poor barrio in the south of Spain. He speaks street Spanish from Spain (European Spanish only, never Latin American). Strong Andalusian street accent: aspirated and dropped S, clipped word endings, melodic lamenting intonation. Hoarse, broken, raspy voice. His normal state is dazed, spaced-out and heavy-lidded: he speaks very slowly with a lazy tongue, drags and stretches every word, lets each phrase trail off, and never sounds alert. Wheedling, always asking for a coin.

episodios.giro: Parecía que solo cargaba el móvil y hay un cultivo en el trastero
